notes: All 12 views inspected. Rear-axle differential cutaway on a bolted stand: a banjo housing cut open to reveal a brass crown wheel, pinion, and spider and side gears, half shafts, wheel flanges with studs, and an input flange. The gear teeth are cut geometry and the internal gear train is genuinely modelled rather than painted. Two SEPARATE rotor nodes carry the spinning elements, so a rotation clip can be authored. The cutaway and stand are intentional for a teaching model and the rotors are separable.
limitations: Stylised Cozy-kit palette rather than photoreal materials.
The housing is deliberately cut away, so this is not usable as a complete sealed axle.
Gear ratios are illustrative, not dimensioned to a real vehicle.
method: Visual inspection of local-model renders and technical reports
